meta.title: Shopify Reorder Point & PO Automation — Reorder Engine
meta.description: Nine apps forecast your Shopify inventory. Not one sends the PO. Reorder Engine is building the missing last mile — proven in shadow against your own orders first.

cash.label: THE CASH TRAP
cash.statement: Cash buried in slow movers while bestsellers stock out

spot.label: THE BLIND SPOT
spot.statement: The spreadsheet can’t tell “low demand” from “nothing to sell”

night.label: THE 11PM JOB
night.statement: Nobody is watching when it breaks — except you, at night

why.title: Why does nobody send the PO?
why.sub: Because a purchase order commits real money — and that takes trust no forecasting tool has earned. So we’re building trust first: it proves itself on your own orders, in shadow, before it touches anything.

ladder.title: Autonomy is earned, never assumed

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.body: 30 days of every PO it would have sent, logged as permanent proof — against your real orders, before it touches anything.

approve.title: Approve
approve.body: It drafts the real PO — MOQs, price breaks, carton rounding. You click send.

autonomy.title: Earn autonomy
autonomy.body: Only inside limits you set, with circuit breakers — and only if the shadow record earns it. You stay in charge.

ladder.footer: Audit → approval → earned autonomy. This is how every Leaf app works — and this app is its fullest expression.
